rationale: retained-ui-kernel: MouseEvent gains an appended scroll_precise field (default true, so existing positional initialisers and every other platform keep today's behaviour) and deliver_mouse_wheel gains a WheelAttributes overload; the existing overloads forward unchanged. Safe: additive, full build green, tests on every wheel route plus confirm_failure controls. No API is removed and no authority boundary moves. Pulp-only under the freeze contract's rule for transferred but unfrozen paths: none of these files is in the pin's frozen_paths, and Vellum's framework copy is separate; if Vellum wants the flag it lands in framework/ first.
